subject: general
question: Jaintia is the name of a tribe as well as a hill range found in the state of ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Jaintia**

__
 
• **Jaintia in Meghalaya can be traced in the Jaintia hills.**
 
• It is **extended from the east of the Shillong Plateau of present-day Meghalaya to the Barak River valley in Assam.**
 
• Jaintia, like Khasis, belongs to the **Proto Autroloid Monkhmer race.**
 
• Jaintia along with Khasis, Wars and Pnars are known as Hynniewtrep.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** three major tribes found in Meghalaya are the Khasis, Jaintias and Garos**.
 
• Besides, there are also other minor tribes living in the State namely, **the Rabhas, Boros, Hajongs and Koches** in the plain areas of Garo Hills.
 
• The **Khasis and Garos are the two largest tribal groups** constituting **56% and 34% **respectively of the scheduled tribes (ST) in Meghalaya.
 
• The **Jaintias** are listed as a sub-tribe under the Khasis, and constitute about **1%** of the tribal population.
